4.source: relic set 110 (Eagle of Twilight Line), 4-piece ability Ability51101: "After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their action is Advanced Forward by #1[i]%." param = [0.25]
4.note: #1[i] -> percent = 0.25. ADVANCE takes the fraction of the target's REMAINING time to act that gets skipped (Queue.advanceActionByPercent), and the target defaults to the owner -- 'their action', not the party's. 'actor == self' keeps the rule to the wearer's own ultimate.
